# Design point P012

## Description

The platform supports low-friction repository migration, while client-side object-database cleanup runs in the background to avoid blocking routine Git commands. Repository writes are acknowledged only after their operations are durably recorded in the WAL, providing a clear durability guarantee alongside migration and maintenance scalability.
